scene_description: A person is performing bottle flip tricks while several friends record the action with their phones in an outdoor setting on a sunny day.

moments.label: Initial wind-up
moments.description: The person crouches slightly, holding the bottle, preparing for the first throw.

moments.label: First bottle release
moments.description: The bottle is mid-air, having just been released from the person's hands during the first flip attempt.

moments.label: First successful flip celebration
moments.description: The person leans back with arms outstretched, celebrating the successful first bottle flip.

moments.label: Pre-jump crouch
moments.description: The person is in a low crouch, holding the bottle with both hands, before initiating the jump-throw.

moments.label: Mid-air jump release
moments.description: The person is at the peak of their jump, releasing the bottle upwards during the second flip attempt.

moments.label: Third throw wind-up
moments.description: The person is holding the bottle horizontally with both hands, preparing for the final throw.

moments.label: Water release mid-air
moments.description: Water visibly streams from the bottle as it is flung through the air during the final, unsuccessful attempt.

moments.label: Bottle spill reaction
moments.description: The person looks down at the spilled water on the ground with a look of dismay after the flip.
